title: Storm Sewer Line Locate
categories: Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways
description: Use this service request to request a storm line-locate. A storm line-locate is most often needed when construction requires a vertical bore or a horizontal bore. Any activity that requires digging near a street or easement should have a line-locate prior to digging. Line-locates are occasionally requested so that construction can plan where to connect a storm drain.The estimated response time for this service request is 5 business days.

observedQuestions.question: Do you need the depth of the line?
Do you need a drawing map?
Do you need an inspector on-site?
Would you like to be contacted?
options: Yes - prior to work being completed
Yes - once the work is completed

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request to locate a storm sewer line before digging.
actions.why: For a storm sewer line locate before construction or excavation near a street or drainage easement, including vertical or horizontal boring or planning a storm-drain connection. The 311 request form asks whether line depth, a drawing, or an on-site inspector is needed.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways" > Choose "Storm Sewer Line Locate"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways" > Choose "Storm Sewer Line Locate"
